description: This script sets up a virtual Ethernet (veth) pair, creates a bridge, adds the veth ends to the bridge, optionally assigns a MAC address to the veth peer based on existing network interfaces, and performs a broadcast connectivity test using socat. It is designed for configuring network interfaces in a Linux environment, specifically for OpenWRT-based systems.

methods.name: set up network interfaces and bridge
methods.description: Creates and configures a network bridge and veth pair, assigns MAC addresses if requested, and verifies the setup.

methods.name: broadcast connectivity test
methods.description: Sends a broadcast message over the veth interface and checks if the message is received, indicating connectivity.
